items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And Clyde Hart was playing in the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. And then I'll never forget, while in Cleveland, McKinney's Cotton Pickers came through there. They had Roy Eldridge, Billy Bowen, Teddy Wilson, Teddy Wilson's brother Gus. Oh, man, what a band he had. What a band he had. And Clyde Hart was playing in the band. And this was later on, after the musicians I'd seen McKinney's Cotton Players -- seen with McKinney's Cotton Pickers in Columbus, they had a drummer, Cuba Austin, and all these guys, you know. But this is later in the years when Roy joined the…
